tables.purpose: Primary daily distillery operations facts; one row per calendar Date (latest timestamp wins). BI maps rows to dashboard series points.
Stores distillery_theoretical_yield (default 64.4) used at form-save time to compute fe, oe, and theoretical_yield columns; not read by distillery BI endpoint but affects stored efficiency values.
Defines season compare windows loaded via GET /api/bi/settings as seasonMapping for Compare chip date alignment.

rows.name: Operating Days
rows.description: Count of filtered daily records where ethanol production is greater than zero. Matches Power BI operating-day logic (not every logged date).
rows.formula: filteredData.filter((row) => Number(row.totalProd) > 0).length where filteredData = rawData filtered by date range [fromDate, toDate] and selected operation modes.
rows.comparison: No comparison chip. Subtitle shows range preset (MTD, QTD, YTD) or custom date span.

rows.name: Op Mode selection count
rows.description: Number of operation modes currently included in all dashboard metrics. Button shows All when all four modes are selected, otherwise the selected count.
rows.formula: selectedModes.length; availableModes = ['B Heavy','C Heavy','Syrup','Mixed']. If selectedModes.length === 0 then filteredData = [] (all metrics zero/empty).

rows.name: Total Ethanol Produced
rows.description: Sum of actual ethanol production (bulk liters) across all days and selected operation modes in the filtered date range.
rows.formula: aggregateKpisFromRows(filteredData).ethanolProd = SUM(row.totalProd). Display: value.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }). Backend: totalProd = num(actual_ethanol_bl).
rows.comparison: Comparison baseline pyKPIs.ethanolProd from comparisonDataSlice (prior period or aligned season window, same mode filter). Percent change: pyValue !== 0 ? ((value - pyValue) / pyValue) * 100 : 0. Shown as Math.abs(delta).toFixed(1)% with trend icon. Label: vs {comparisonLabel} {periodLabel}. Normal coloring (higher is better).

rows.name: Total Ethanol Produced comparison %
rows.description: Period-over-period or season percent change for total ethanol production versus the selected comparison window.
rows.formula: delta = pyValue !== 0 ? ((currentKPIs.ethanolProd - pyKPIs.ethanolProd) / pyKPIs.ethanolProd) * 100 : 0; display Math.abs(delta).toFixed(1).
rows.comparison: Hidden only when pyValue is 0 (shows 0.0% neutral). comparisonLabel pattern: PP -> '{priorPeriodRange.label} ({start} - {end})'; season -> '{seasonLabel} ({start} - {end})' with en-US short dates.

rows.name: Total Ethanol Produced sparkline
rows.description: Daily actual ethanol production over the filtered period shown as a KPI sparkline area chart.
rows.formula: Per day: totalProd = num(actual_ethanol_bl). Tooltip: v.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + ' BL'.
rows.comparison: Sparkline shows current period only; no overlay of comparison period.

rows.name: Syrup/Molasses Consumed
rows.description: Sum of syrup and molasses feed consumed (quintals) across the filtered date range and selected modes.
rows.formula: aggregateKpisFromRows(filteredData).syrupMol = SUM(row.syrupMolConsumed). Backend: syrupMolConsumed = num(syrup_molasses_qtls).
rows.comparison: Percent change vs pyKPIs.syrupMol with inverseColor=true (lower increase is green). Formula same as ethanol KPI.

rows.name: Syrup/Molasses Consumed comparison %
rows.description: Percent change in total syrup/molasses consumption versus comparison window.
rows.formula: delta = pyValue !== 0 ? ((currentKPIs.syrupMol - pyKPIs.syrupMol) / pyKPIs.syrupMol) * 100 : 0.

rows.name: Syrup/Molasses Consumed sparkline
rows.description: Daily syrup/molasses consumption sparkline.
rows.formula: Per day: syrupMolConsumed = num(syrup_molasses_qtls).

rows.name: Fermentation Efficiency
rows.description: Average fermentation efficiency (FE) across days in range, skipping blank and zero values. FE measures alcohol produced in fermentation versus theoretical yield from fermentable sugar.
rows.formula: aggregateKpisFromRows: fermEff = averageNonBlank(rows, (item) => item.fermEff, { skipZero: true }). Backend per row: fermEff = effPercent(fe) where effPercent(x) = x if |x|>1 else x*100 (ratio 0-1 converted to percent). Stored fe at form save: fe = alcohol_prod_fermentation / theoretical_yield; theoretical_yield = fs_quantity * theoreticalYieldFactor. [USES portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield at form-save time, default 64.4]
rows.source: distillery_operations.fe, distillery_operations.alcohol_pct, distillery_operations.wash_distilled, distillery_operations.trs, distillery_operations.ufs, distillery_operations.syrup_molasses_qtls, portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield (indirect via stored fe)
rows.comparison: Percent change vs pyKPIs.fermEff. Normal coloring (higher is better).

rows.name: Fermentation Efficiency comparison %
rows.description: Percent change in average FE versus comparison window.
rows.formula: delta = pyValue !== 0 ? ((currentKPIs.fermEff - pyKPIs.fermEff) / pyKPIs.fermEff) * 100 : 0.
rows.comparison: Depends on portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield used when each row's fe was saved. Label vs {comparisonLabel} {periodLabel}.

rows.name: Fermentation Efficiency sparkline
rows.description: Daily FE trend in KPI card sparkline.
rows.formula: Per day: fermEff = effPercent(distillery_operations.fe). Tooltip suffix %.
rows.comparison: Current period only. [Indirect dependency on portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield via stored fe]

rows.name: Distillation Efficiency
rows.description: Average distillation efficiency (DE) across days, skipping blank and zero values. DE is recovery of alcohol in distillation relative to fermentation alcohol.
rows.formula: aggregateKpisFromRows: distEff = averageNonBlank(rows, (item) => item.distEff, { skipZero: true }). Backend: distEff = effPercent(de). Stored de at form save: de = actual_prod_al / alcohol_prod_fermentation where actual_prod_al = (al_bl_ratio_pct/100)*actual_ethanol_bl and alcohol_prod_fermentation = (alcohol_pct/100)*wash_distilled.
rows.comparison: Percent change vs pyKPIs.distEff. Normal coloring.

rows.name: Distillation Efficiency comparison %
rows.description: Percent change in average DE versus comparison window.
rows.formula: delta = pyValue !== 0 ? ((currentKPIs.distEff - pyKPIs.distEff) / pyKPIs.distEff) * 100 : 0.

rows.name: Distillation Efficiency sparkline
rows.description: Daily DE trend in KPI card sparkline.
rows.formula: Per day: distEff = effPercent(distillery_operations.de).

rows.name: Ethanol Vol chart title comparison %
rows.description: Percent change between the mean daily total ethanol in the current period and the mean daily total in the comparison period.
rows.formula: currentAvg = SUM(item.totalProd for filteredData) / filteredData.length; pyAvg = SUM(item.totalProd for comparisonData) / comparisonData.length (or 0 if empty); delta = pyAvg !== 0 ? ((currentAvg - pyAvg) / pyAvg) * 100 : 0; display Math.abs(delta).toFixed(1). Badge text: ({periodLabel}) . {comparisonLabel}.
rows.comparison: higherIsBetter=true (default). Shown in chart title row only when filteredData.length > 0.

rows.name: Total Vol
rows.description: Sum of daily ethanol production across the filtered period shown above the Ethanol Vol chart.
rows.formula: getChartMetric('totalProd', true) = SUM(Number(item.totalProd) || 0) over filteredData. formatMetric: >=1e6 -> (n/1e6).toFixed(2)+M; >=1e3 -> (n/1e3).toFixed(2)+K; else n.toFixed(2).
rows.comparison: Sub-line shows comparison period aggregate via getChartMetric('totalProd', true, comparisonData), not percent change.

rows.name: Total Vol vs comparison value
rows.description: Formatted comparison-window total ethanol shown as '| vs {comparisonLabel}: {value}'.
rows.formula: formatMetric(getChartMetric('totalProd', true, comparisonData), { asPercent: false }).
rows.comparison: Displays comparison period absolute value, not delta percent.

rows.name: Avg REC BL
rows.description: Average daily recovery in bulk liters per quintal of feed (REC BL) across the period, skipping blank and zero days.
rows.formula: getChartMetric('recovery', false) = averageNonBlank(filteredData, (item) => item.recovery, { skipZero: true }). Per row: recovery = rec_bl if rec_bl != 0 else (syrup_molasses_qtls > 0 ? actual_ethanol_bl / syrup_molasses_qtls : 0).
rows.comparison: Sub-line: formatMetric(getChartMetric('recovery', false, comparisonData), { asPercent: false }).

rows.name: Avg REC BL vs comparison value
rows.description: Comparison-window average REC BL formatted alongside Total Vol.
rows.formula: formatMetric(getChartMetric('recovery', false, comparisonData), { asPercent: false }).
rows.comparison: Absolute comparison value, not percent change.

rows.name: B Heavy (BL)
rows.description: Daily ethanol attributed to B Heavy operation mode as a stacked bar segment.
rows.formula: bHeavyProd = actual_ethanol_bl when trim(operation_mode) = 'B Heavy', else 0. Y-axis left tickFormatter: v/1000 + 'k'.

rows.name: C Heavy (BL)
rows.description: Daily ethanol attributed to C Heavy operation mode.
rows.formula: cHeavyProd = actual_ethanol_bl when operation_mode = 'C Heavy', else 0.

rows.name: Syrup (BL)
rows.description: Daily ethanol attributed to Syrup operation mode.
rows.formula: syrupProd = actual_ethanol_bl when operation_mode = 'Syrup', else 0.

rows.name: Mixed (BL)
rows.description: Daily ethanol for Mixed/unknown modes. operation_mode 'None' or blank is mapped to Mixed.
rows.formula: mixedProd = actual_ethanol_bl when mode not in ('B Heavy','C Heavy','Syrup'); mode = Mixed when operation_mode is None or empty.

rows.name: REC BL
rows.description: Daily recovery line (ethanol BL per quintal feed) on right Y-axis.
rows.formula: recovery per mapRowToBiPoint (see Avg REC BL). Right Y-axis tickFormatter: Number(v).toFixed(0). Tooltip: no % suffix for REC BL.

rows.name: Ferm. Sugar chart title comparison %
rows.description: Percent change in mean daily fermentable sugar percent (FS/TRS) between current and comparison periods.
rows.formula: ChartTitle dataKey='fermSugar': currentAvg = AVG(item.fermSugar); delta vs pyAvg on comparisonData.

rows.name: Avg Ferm. Sugar
rows.description: Average daily fermentable sugar as percent of TRS (FS/TRS x 100), skipping blank and zero days.
rows.formula: getChartMetric('fermSugar', false) = averageNonBlank(..., { skipZero: true }). Per row: fsPctRatio = fs/trs when trs valid else 0; fermSugar = fsPctRatio !== 0 ? fsPctRatio * 100 : num(fs) [fallback when ratio is 0].
rows.comparison: formatMetric displays as X.X%. Sub-line shows comparison period average.

rows.name: Avg Ferm. Sugar vs comparison value
rows.description: Comparison-window average fermentable sugar percent.
rows.formula: formatMetric(getChartMetric('fermSugar', false, comparisonData), { asPercent: true }).
rows.comparison: Absolute comparison average, not percent change.

rows.name: Avg Alcohol
rows.description: Average daily wash alcohol percent across the period, skipping blank and zero days.
rows.formula: getChartMetric('alcohol', false) = averageNonBlank(filteredData, (item) => item.alcohol, { skipZero: true }). Per row: alcohol = num(alcohol_pct).

rows.name: Avg Alcohol vs comparison value
rows.description: Comparison-window average alcohol percent.
rows.formula: formatMetric(getChartMetric('alcohol', false, comparisonData), { asPercent: true }).

rows.name: Ferm. Sugar %
rows.description: Daily fermentable sugar percent line (FS/TRS).
rows.formula: fermSugar per mapRowToBiPoint. Y-axis tickFormatter: v.toFixed(2) + '%'.

rows.name: Alcohol %
rows.description: Daily wash alcohol percent line.
rows.formula: alcohol = num(alcohol_pct).

rows.name: Overall Efficiency chart title comparison %
rows.description: Percent change in mean daily fermentation efficiency between periods (chart title uses dataKey fermEff).
rows.formula: ChartTitle dataKey='fermEff': AVG(fermEff) current vs comparison.

rows.name: Avg FE
rows.description: Average fermentation efficiency for the chart header metrics row.
rows.formula: getChartMetric('fermEff', false) with skipZero average.
rows.comparison: Sub-line: comparison period Avg FE. [USES portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield at form-save via stored fe]

rows.name: Avg FE vs comparison value
rows.description: Comparison-window average FE.
rows.formula: formatMetric(getChartMetric('fermEff', false, comparisonData)).

rows.name: Avg DE
rows.description: Average distillation efficiency for the chart header metrics row.
rows.formula: getChartMetric('distEff', false) with skipZero average.

rows.name: Avg DE vs comparison value
rows.description: Comparison-window average DE.
rows.formula: formatMetric(getChartMetric('distEff', false, comparisonData)).

rows.name: Avg OE
rows.description: Average overall efficiency (OE = FE x DE) across days, skipping blank and zero values.
rows.formula: getChartMetric('overallEff', false). Per row: overallEff = effPercent(oe) if oe present, else (fermEff/100)*(distEff/100)*100. Stored oe at form save: oe = fe * de. [USES portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield at form-save via fe and oe]

rows.name: Avg OE vs comparison value
rows.description: Comparison-window average overall efficiency.
rows.formula: formatMetric(getChartMetric('overallEff', false, comparisonData)).

rows.name: Ferm. Efficiency
rows.description: Daily fermentation efficiency line.
rows.formula: fermEff = effPercent(fe). Y-axis domain ['dataMin - 2', 100].
rows.comparison: Current period only. [USES portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield at form-save via stored fe]

rows.name: Dist. Efficiency
rows.description: Daily distillation efficiency line.
rows.formula: distEff = effPercent(de).

rows.name: Overall Eff (OE)
rows.description: Daily overall efficiency line (OE).
rows.formula: overallEff from mapRowToBiPoint (oe column or FE*DE fallback).
rows.comparison: Current period only. [USES portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield at form-save via fe/oe]

rows.name: Wash Distilled chart title comparison %
rows.description: Percent change in mean daily wash distilled volume.
rows.formula: ChartTitle dataKey='totalWash': AVG(totalWash) current vs comparison.

rows.name: Total Wash
rows.description: Sum of wash distilled across the filtered period.
rows.formula: getChartMetric('totalWash', true) = SUM(num(wash_distilled)). formatMetric without percent.

rows.name: Total Wash vs comparison value
rows.description: Comparison-window total wash distilled.
rows.formula: formatMetric(getChartMetric('totalWash', true, comparisonData), { asPercent: false }).

rows.name: Wash Volume
rows.description: Daily wash distilled area series.
rows.formula: totalWash = num(wash_distilled). Y-axis tickFormatter: (v/1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M'.

rows.name: Molasses Stock chart title comparison %
rows.description: Percent change in mean daily molasses inventory between periods.
rows.formula: ChartTitle dataKey='molInStore', higherIsBetter=false: lower average stock is green in title chip.

rows.name: Avg Stock
rows.description: Average daily BH+CH molasses in store, skipping null blanks but including real zeros.
rows.formula: getChartMetric('molInStore', false) = averageNonBlank(..., { skipZero: false }). Per row: molInStore = null when both total_bh_molasses_qtls and total_ch_molasses_qtls blank; else COALESCE(bh,0)+COALESCE(ch,0).

rows.name: Molasses Avg Stock vs comparison value
rows.description: Comparison-window average molasses stock.
rows.formula: formatMetric(getChartMetric('molInStore', false, comparisonData), { asPercent: false }).

rows.name: Molasses Stock
rows.description: Daily molasses inventory area series.
rows.formula: molInStore per molInStoreFromRow. Y-axis: (v/1000).toFixed(0) + 'k'.

rows.name: Ethanol Stock chart title comparison %
rows.description: Percent change in mean daily finished ethanol inventory.
rows.formula: ChartTitle dataKey='ethInStore', higherIsBetter=false.

rows.name: Avg Stock
rows.description: Average daily ethanol in storage, skipping null blanks but including real zeros.
rows.formula: getChartMetric('ethInStore', false) = averageNonBlank(..., { skipZero: false }). Per row: ethInStore = nullableNum(ethanol_storage_bl).

rows.name: Ethanol Avg Stock vs comparison value
rows.description: Comparison-window average ethanol stock.
rows.formula: formatMetric(getChartMetric('ethInStore', false, comparisonData), { asPercent: false }).

rows.name: Ethanol Stock
rows.description: Daily finished ethanol inventory area series.
rows.formula: ethInStore = nullableNum(ethanol_storage_bl). Y-axis: (v/1000).toFixed(0) + 'k'.

rows.name: Operating Days period badge
rows.description: Badge shown when a chart is expanded: count of operating days and period label.
rows.formula: {operatingDays} Operating Days ({periodLabel}) where operatingDays = filteredData.filter(row => Number(row.totalProd) > 0).length.

rows.name: Comparison window label
rows.description: Human-readable comparison range appended to KPI and chart comparison chips.
rows.formula: PP: '{priorPeriodRange.label} ({formatDateFriendly(start)} - {formatDateFriendly(end)})' where priorPeriodRange = computePriorPeriodRange(fromDate, toDate, rangePreset). MTD->Prev. Month (shift -1 month); QTD->Prev. Quarter (-3 months); YTD->Prev. Year (-1 year); Custom->equal-length window ending day before fromDate. Season: '{seasonLabel} ({start} - {end})' from resolveCockpitCompareRange or alignSeasonCompareRange.
rows.comparison: Empty string when comparisonType is not PP and not a season type.

rows.name: Theoretical yield (form-save only, not displayed)
rows.description: Not shown on dashboard but drives stored FE/OE values. Computed when distillery_ops form is saved.
rows.formula: theoretical_yield = fs_quantity * theoreticalYieldFactor where fs_quantity = (fs/100)*syrup_molasses_qtls, fs = trs - ufs, theoreticalYieldFactor = parseFloat(portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield) default 64.4. fe = alcohol_prod_fermentation / theoretical_yield. oe = fe * de. [USES portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield]
rows.source: portal_settings.distillery_theoretical_yield, distillery_operations.trs, distillery_operations.ufs, distillery_operations.syrup_molasses_qtls, distillery_operations.alcohol_pct, distillery_operations.wash_distilled, distillery_operations.al_bl_ratio_pct, distillery_operations.actual_ethanol_bl
rows.comparison: Not displayed on dashboard. Historical rows retain yield factor active at save time.
